theorem_scope: Standard four-regular Cayley graphs of <a,b | (ab^i)^(p_i)=1, i in J>, J a subset of positive integers and primes p_i >= 13.
imported_input: Classical C'(1/6) Greendlinger-Dehn reduced-word criterion, including its linear-subword form; standard elementary Galton-Watson, Bernoulli ergodicity, finite energy and Harris positive association.
proof_does_not_use: earlier broad two-generator or bounded-exponent cost deductions
cost-one property of the constructed groups
finite-graph eigenvalues as estimates for the infinite Cayley graph
critical_audit_points: Proper-power rotations are deduplicated in the symmetrized set.
The embedded-language comparison uses LINEAR sign runs and the LINEAR Dehn criterion, not an unproved cyclic bound.
The C_p*C_p subgroup proof uses centered exponents and is checked separately from both free-subgroup arguments.
Independence holds between future offspring counts on disjoint descendant trees, not between indicators within one count.
Nonbacktracking walks with repeated edges are not assigned probabilities p^k; the valid simple-path union bound is enlarged by their nonnegative weights.
The operator series is only used below its smaller convergence root.
All numerical interval endpoints, positivity and random-walk bounds have exact rational checks.
Finite checks are not validation of infinite theorems; some exact-arithmetic tests use seeded samples rather than exhaustive input sets.
The numerical interval is not claimed for other generating sets or for general Burnside groups.
Previous cumulative research nodes remain provenance and are not globally re-audited.

cairn.semantics: Dependency consistency only; ESTABLISHED records a written proof route, not formal theorem verification.
